_desc: ★ THE A6 CONTROL RUN for s35a (spec §5 A6 + §10.5). Byte-for-byte the same four STATIC nodes as s35a — same ids/keys/layer/PHY/links/seed/beacon period — same four S1->S4 DMs at the same at_ms, with the FOUR TEAM NODES REMOVED. The statics are listed FIRST in both files so their node indices (0-3) are identical and the two streams are directly comparable. A6 = "static delivery in s35a is identical to this run": isolation costs the static plane nothing but airtime. ⚠ The comparison is DELIVERY (arrivals + the dm_delivery_breakdown table), NOT byte-identity: eight co-channel transmitters legitimately shift timing, and §10.3 records four plane-BLIND dedup ledgers (_seen_origins, _per_origin_channel, _hash_query_seen, _mediated_recent) whose keys a team local id and a static id can alias in — those SUPPRESS rather than leak, so a delivery difference here is an airtime/dedup finding to characterise, not automatically an isolation breach.
